title: The Bell Rings Again
description: The mysterious bell continues to ring and people disappear

story: Well done, it looks like everyone is here!
"We'll stay in here to keep safe. I'm so grateful for everything you've done."
Use 'cat' to check that the animals are happy in here.
hints: Use 'cat' to examine an animal, e.g. 'cat Daisy'.

story: Ruth: "What?? I heard a bell! What does that mean?"
Quick! Look around and see if anyone is missing.
It appears that everyone is still here...
Ruth: "I heard it again! Is that the sound you heard when my husband went missing?"
Ruth: "It's alright. We're all safe, everyone's still here. I wonder why it's ringing?"
Perhaps we should investigate that sound. Who else do we know?
Maybe you should check back on the family in the .hidden-shelter and talk to them with your new found voice.
Start heading back to the .hidden-shelter using 'cd'.
hints: We can go directly to the .hidden-shelter using 'cd ~/town/.hidden-shelter'
